name: sqlpulse
description: Modern SQL Query Management & Automation Platform

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --workspace=frontend && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=scheduler
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:scheduler"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=scheduler
